requirements.requirement: The system must transform PI name from the data contract into a display-ready string without modification when present.
The system must format the institution field into a human-readable string suitable for UI display.
The system must convert prior trial count into a formatted numeric label (e.g., integer with no decimals).
The system must append a unit label (e.g., 'trials') to the prior trial count for display consistency.
The system must map publication indicator boolean values into a user-facing label (e.g., 'Published' or 'No publications found').
The system must compute a visual score contribution indicator based on the PI score contribution value provided in the data contract.
The system must normalize the score contribution into a bounded range suitable for UI visualization (e.g., 0–100 or equivalent scale).
The system must output a structured object compatible with the MessageBubble.tsx rendering pipeline.
The system must conditionally exclude fields from the output when their corresponding input values are null or undefined.
The system must preserve field ordering in the output to match the UI data contract defined in EVAL-CT-PI-UX-S1.
The system must provide a fallback display label 'Unknown Investigator' when PI name is missing.
The system must provide a fallback display label 'Institution not available' when institution data is missing.
The system must default prior trial count to 0 when the value is missing or invalid.
The system must suppress the score contribution indicator when the contribution value is null or cannot be computed.
The system must ensure all transformed fields are serializable into JSON without runtime errors.
